title: Banach-valued graph limits: Graphon representability and Banach-space structure
summary: We study a graph-limit problem for Banach-decorated graphs. Given a sequence of $X$-decorated graphs whose homomorphism densities converge against all $X^*$-decorated test graphs, we ask whether the limiting densities are represented by an $X$-valued graphon. The results connect this graph-limit problem with Banach-space structure. If $X^*$ is separable, then the graphon representation property for graph sequences uniformly bounded in $L^p$ for every finite $p$ holds if and only if $X$ is reflexive.
